meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 用户问起以前会话里做过的事时,Claude 会先搜索跨会话记忆库,给出带编号的结果列表和时间线,再筛选,只对被选中的记录读取全文;只有需要精确原始输出时才调取原始工具数据。
howto.when: 当用户的问题指向“之前的会话”而非当前对话时触发,例如问“这个我们之前解决过吗”“上次怎么做的 X”“上周发生了什么”。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决登录超时的?
say.note: 触发对历史会话的记忆搜索。

say.text: 把上周数据库迁移失败的原始报错找出来。
say.note: 摘要不够时会读取原始工具输出。

say.text: 我们之前讨论过用哪个缓存方案吗?

howto.what_en: When the user asks about work done in previous sessions, Claude searches the cross-session memory store: first returns an indexed list and timeline, filters, then fetches full records only for shortlisted IDs; raw tool I/O is opened only when exact output is required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the question concerns previous sessions rather than the current conversation—e.g. “did we already fix this?”, “how did we do X last time?”, “what happened last week?”.

say_en.text: How did we resolve the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Triggers a search across past sessions.

say_en.text: Pull up the raw error from last week's failed DB migration.
say_en.note: Reads the stored tool response when summaries are unclear.

say_en.text: Did we ever settle on a caching approach?
